items.text: Noticing it is already the beginning of letting go.
You came here and wrote it down. That's enough.
Even if the words don't come out right, what you feel is real.
You can let go without knowing why.
No need to blame. The one who noticed the replay is already standing outside it.
However many times it returns, you can release it as many times.
You don't have to feel it. The words alone are enough.
If you can offer one word, today is enough.
Being able to say "I don't know" is strength.
Right now, you're the one watching the replay.
Just knowing you don't have to change them makes it lighter.
You noticed the child inside.
You don't need to release it perfectly. A little lighter is enough.
Noticing the fixation proves you can stand outside it.
As much as you've let go of the outcome, you've made room.
Thank you for coming back here today.
This is enough for today. Leave the rest to tomorrow's you.
Letting go before sleep may be today's most important work.
Noticing the replay won't stop, and still offering a word. That's the practice.
The way back to zero is always inside.
